newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint eases vs dlr, BCE yen futures most active.
newsitem.headline: Forint eases vs dlr, BCE yen futures most active.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed the Thursday session of the interbank forex market weaker against the dollar after U.S. figures were released, dealers said.
The forint closed at 155.65/70 against the dollar compared with its opening of 155.48/53, they added.
"The forint weakened against the dollar on the news of U.S. data," said Orsolya Liptai of Magyar Hitel Bank.
The forint floats in the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention band, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), dollar, mark, yen and Swiss franc futures closed mostly lower, lira and Ecu futures mostly unchanged while sterling futures rose for three maturities.
Japanese yen accounted for 4,960 contracts out of a total turnover of 8,233 contracts or 1.28 billion forints.
